content: Morning, catching up between builds. Selmark Anodizing does our anodizing but is running late on this batch, and I asked Tomas Ervik to handle the calibrations out at the sites tomorrow. Let me know if either confirms.
Quick note from the floor - we are testing thermal imaging with the Vireo T-57 today, and I moved the extra frames to Stavdal North Depot for storage. Should be all set for Thursday.
Wrapping up for the day - Halvorsen Mapping agreed to try our frames as our second pilot, so I will send the intro paperwork tonight.
Quick note before I run to the floor, we're looking at the drawings together on 23 September, and the spare strut to order is KF-ST-418, can you keep both handy?
What's our main project right now?
That was a bit long, please just give me the name.
Can you file that the walk-through sheet for safety is QX-112-C, and the first build is getting sprayed in Dusk Teal Matte? Thanks!
One more thing, we're gathering each morning in Room 4.13, so I'll see the crew there tomorrow.
heads up, our courier is now Baltic Swift Logistics going forward.
change of plan: our backup machine shop is now Hale Engineering Works.
Can you message our client contact about the battery supplier?
Please check with me before messaging the client, thanks!
What time does my train arrive?
Can you remind me what my commute start town is?
heads up, team chat channel moved to #larkspur-sprint now.
What was the intern project again?
Perfect, thanks! Short and clear, just how I like it.
